 Versus  The Union of India through Central bureau of Investigation, Patna Bihar  Bihar  ... ... Opposite Party

======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Prem Kumar  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Nivedita Nirvikar  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SUNIL KUMAR PANWAR  ORAL ORDER 7 19-06-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

The petitioner has prayed for regular bail in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 120(B), 420, 467, 468 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 13(3) r/w 13(1)(d) of the Prevention of Corruption Act.

As per prosecution case, during the period of demonetization, 41 fake Bank accounts were opened in three Branches of Bihar Awami Co-operative Bank Limited, on the basis of identity proof, address proof and other requirements arranged by cheating innocent persons.
The petitioner is alleged to be involved in the alleged offence.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence.
He has Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.57494 of 2022(7) dt.19-06-2023 falsely been implicated in this case.
The main allegation against other co-accused Md. Arshad Ahmed, who is director of Bihar Awami Co-operative Bank Ltd. and Mother International Academy.
On his instance, those accounts were opened.

The petitioner is staff of the Mother International Academy and only allegation against him is to fill up the account opening forms in the name of employees of Praveen Kumar Singh vs The Union Of India Through Central ... on 19 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/77647491/
1 the said Academy.

sentences.text:
It is further submitted that other co-accused Arun Kumar has already been granted bail by a co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 6.4.2023 passed in Cr. Misc. No.
43437 of 2022 upon whom the similar allegation has been made, hence, the case of this petitioner stands on similar footing of that of the co- accused.
A statement has been made in para-3 of the petition that the petitioner has got no criminal antecedent.
Moreover, the petitioner is languishing in judicial custody since 19.7.2022.
Learned APP appearing for the state has opposed the prayer of regular bail.
Having heard learned counsel for the parties and considering the facts and circumstances of the case as well as custody of the petitioner, this court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

The above named petitioner is directed to be released on bail in connection with R/C 6 of 2017 and Spl. Case Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.57494 of 2022(7) dt.19-06-2023 no. 5 of 2017 on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Special Judge, C.B.I.-1st, Patna.

(Sunil Kumar Panwar, J) Amandeep/-
